entries.title: TT Kart
entries.mode_basis: Creator README describes human players sharing one device; short guest check verifies single-player core only
entries.ai_quote: A 3D kart racer for the boys, built with Claude Code from plain JavaScript and Three.js on the shared Claude Games kit.

gameplay.input: Selected 1 PLAYER, selected default driver/course and pressed GO; then pressed ArrowUp and ArrowLeft on page body.
gameplay.response: Race began; elapsed timer advanced from 0:00.0 to 0:05.2; player kart changed on-screen position relative to track/rivals and position indicator improved from 7th to 5th. Lap HUD visible.

entries.ai_quote: It's built with Claude Code from plain JavaScript and Three.js, in the same style as Metro Surfer and the other Teddy & Tommy games.

gameplay.input: Muted via in-game checkbox then clicked Play; dragged backward from ball toward bottom of canvas to putt.
gameplay.response: HUD advanced from TEDDY 0 to TEDDY 1 strokes and golfer/ball moved on the first hole. Current HUD shows Hole 1 / 9.

entries.title: TT Word Pop
entries.mode_basis: Creator README describes human players sharing one device; short guest check verifies single-player core only
entries.ai_quote: It's built with Claude Code from plain JavaScript and Three.js, on the shared Claude Games kit (the blocky boys, their poses, synth sound, the ? keys panel and English / 中文).

gameplay.input: Pressed key Z for the pictured zebra word’s first missing letter.
gameplay.response: Z balloon popped in a burst and a Z animation appeared; first answer slot transitioned from dotted/active empty state to plain filled slot. The game’s help confirms letters pop their matching balloons and word letters are entered in order.
